This is a natural-looking recessed fish tank.
[/size][/color][/center]
The fish tanks are sold by Willy.
Furniture to fill in the spaces between is sold by Robin.

Each of the spacers added in version 1.1 is available at the corresponding sales outlets.
(Those with flowers are sold by Robin.)
[spoiler]Clouds Banner : Decoration Boat at Night Market
 Icy Banner : Festival of Ice
Moonlight Jellies Banner : Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
Pastel Banner : Egg Festival
Winter Banner : Feast of the Winter Star
[/spoiler]
There are also a few combinations of multiple fish tanks in the middle room, as shown in the example in the Media image.

"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14722]TV with stand[/url]" created during the production process was uploaded as a separate mod.
Vanilla graphics users are recommended to use it with this mod.

Note: The images in Media are a mixture of those using the color reduction mod and vanilla shades.

The currently supported recolor mods are...
Supported in version 1.2 : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interior[/url]
Supported in version 1.3 : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]
Supported in version 1.3 : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11597]Asters Beam Mod[/url] (CherryDark and CherryMedium color)
Supported in version 1.4 : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley World Recolor[/url]


Note: As a way to accommodate the recolor mod, we are re-coloring the original tile sheet with reference to that color.
The file itself is not copied and used, but if there is a problem, please let us know.
